summary: A phishing email with a Spanish-language invoice lure (subject "ENVIO DOCUMENTOS FACTURA 4558") carried a RAR v5 attachment that delivered a JavaScript file which pulls down XWorm. Post-infection traffic from the infected Windows host went to TCP 43.228.157.141:7007. The infection did not survive a reboot of the host.
